title: Part History columns keep their width for a short entry
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · about 10 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [Admin] = you, signed in with the Admin role, which by default has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Location: [Loc-1] = the location picked in the top-bar location switcher at the start; every step runs at [Loc-1] unless it names another location.
  • Data: [Part-A] = tracked part whose only status entry is a short "Deactivated". [Part-B] = tracked part with a long "Description updated" entry.
  • Browser: the same window size for both pages (do not resize between steps).
  • Names and numbers marked (e.g. …) are examples only. What must hold is the status (active or inactive), tracking, quantity and link described above.

Setup

  1. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL COLWIDTH A), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-COLWIDTH-01), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  2. [Part-A] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-COLWIDTH-01); [Desc-A] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL COLWIDTH A).
  3. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL COLWIDTH B), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-COLWIDTH-02), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  4. [Part-B] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-COLWIDTH-02); [Desc-B] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL COLWIDTH B).
  5. Set [Part-A] inactive: on the Active tab search [Part-A], click its row, pick Part Status "Inactive", click Save, leave the note empty and click "Deactivate" in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation.
  6. Open [Part-B], replace its Description with a long text (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST PL COLWIDTH B WITH A VERY LONG DESCRIPTION THAT FILLS THE EVENT COLUMN FROM EDGE TO EDGE") and click Save.
  7. Check the setup worked: [Part-A]'s Part History shows "Deactivated"; [Part-B]'s shows a long "Description updated | Original description: … | New description: …" entry.
custom_steps:
1. Open [Part-A]'s Part History and take a screenshot.
  2. Open [Part-B]'s Part History and take a screenshot.
  3. Compare the two screenshots.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: The short "Deactivated" entry sits in the Event column; Staff, Date and Time are not widened by it.
  • Step 3: The Staff, Date and Time columns have the same widths and positions on both pages; only the Event column's text differs.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v26 (Ready for dev), S10-R21, read 8 Oct 2026; design canvas boards 3.8 and 2.4 (Part History); board 2.6 shows narrower columns with long entries, the PRD wins. Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-R21: “The Part History table keeps its column layout whatever an entry says. A short entry does not widen the Staff, Date or Time columns.”
